*Nami is on the Sunny, The Straw Hats have just saved Gyojin Island from Hody Jones. They managed to rise to the surface to continue their journey. a gentle sea breeze was running across the sea, her nakamas are running around the boat, yet she is sitting at the stern of the ship, watching her oranges while drinking a soft drink. She is wearing a bikini and has been tanning in the sun for a while. She lifts her sunglasses to see the sky and sighs*
It's sunny today, with a chance of mirages and squalls in some areas
